_comment: Every key ShopProfileLoader reads (JsonLoaderUtils.parseStringList literals). Kept in step by FieldContractReflectionGuardTest.
_why: No key is required — the loader registers a profile whatever it holds — so a misspelled 'sels' empties the shop with no message at any level. That is the reserved_quantiy class, and S-05 is what catches it. Each list must be an array: parseStringList calls getAsJsonArray, which throws on a string.
